# Books & Friends

> An intimate six-member private book club and literary salon across Istanbul, Dubai, New York, and San Francisco, reading one curated book per month since November 2025.

Founded by Cemre Şirin and curated by Eda Aydoğan. All correspondence and membership referral inquiries can be sent to hello@booksnfriends.com.

## Key Pages
- [The Collective Bookshelf (Home)](https://booksnfriends.com/): Browse all 10 curated books, Book of the Month highlight, and club reading stats.
- [Book of the Month](https://booksnfriends.com/book-of-month): Current monthly selection, synopsis, discussion themes, and member reflections.
- [Meet the Friends](https://booksnfriends.com/members): Profiles, 2026 reading goals, and personal shelves of our 6 members.
- [About Books & Friends](https://booksnfriends.com/about): Collective mission, curatorial history, and member directory.
- [Contact & Inquiries](https://booksnfriends.com/contact): Editorial email (hello@booksnfriends.com) and Salon Dispatch newsletter signup.
- [Terms of Use](https://booksnfriends.com/terms): Salon guidelines, contributor rights, and affiliate disclosure.
- [Privacy Policy](https://booksnfriends.com/privacy): Data stewardship, Google Workspace OAuth notice, and deletion requests.

## Agent & Machine-Readable Endpoints
- [MCP Server Card (SEP-1649)](https://booksnfriends.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Model Context Protocol capability card.
- [MCP Streamable HTTP Endpoint](https://booksnfriends.com/mcp): JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP tools and resources endpoint.
- [Structured Club Data JSON](https://booksnfriends.com/api/data): Full JSON snapshot of curated books and members.
- [XML Sitemap](https://booksnfriends.com/sitemap.xml): Complete list of indexable public URLs.

## Current Book of the Month
- **Born a Crime** (Suçlu Doğmak) by Trevor Noah — curated by Mert (Can Mert)
  The compelling, inspiring, and comically inventive story of a young man coming of age in South Africa during the twilight of apartheid and the tumultuous days of freedom that followed.

## Curated Bookshelf
- **Born a Crime** — Trevor Noah (Autobiography & Social Satire, 304 pages, curated by Mert (Can Mert))
- **Istanbul: Memories and the City** — Orhan Pamuk (Memoir & Literary Geography, 440 pages, curated by Gökçe Nur Uysal)
- **The Wall** — Marlen Haushofer (Dystopian Classic & Solitude, 288 pages, curated by Gizem Yeniçıkan)
- **Death in Venice** — Thomas Mann (Modernist Novella & Aesthetics, 104 pages, curated by Ferhat Babacan)
- **Time Shelter** — Georgi Gospodinov (Speculative Fiction & Memory, 392 pages, curated by Gizem Yeniçıkan)
- **The Doors of Perception** — Aldous Huxley (Philosophical Essay & Consciousness, 96 pages, curated by Cemre Şirin)
- **The Almanack of Naval Ravikant** — Eric Jorgenson (Philosophy & Wealth Creation, 244 pages, curated by Eda Aydoğan)
- **The Fifth Agreement** — Don Miguel Ruiz & Don Jose Ruiz (Toltec Wisdom & Mindfulness, 248 pages, curated by Eda Aydoğan)
- **Designing Your Life** — Bill Burnett & Dave Evans (Design Thinking & Personal Growth, 272 pages, curated by Mert (Can Mert))
- **Living in the Display Window** — Nurdan Gürbilek (Cultural Criticism & Philosophy, 208 pages, curated by Cemre Şirin)
